{{Top|leg}}
'''ActionWorld''' was a resort island on [[Dorumaa]] with a focus on sporting activities. It was [[Tropix island]]'s closest neighbor, located to the south. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]] had a facility hidden under the island which could only be reached by an underwater entrance. After her capture by [[Kal Skirata]] and [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]], Skirata set off explosives to destroy the facility. This resulted in one of ActionWorld's sports fields subsiding. [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], also seeking after Ko Sai, spent some time excavating the field, seeking clues of Ko Sai's fate.
